title: The Schleitheim Confession
author: Swiss Brethren

source.license_notes: 1527 text; English translation by Rod and Staff Publishers (Sixth Printing, 1985). Public domain by age.

notes: Drafted by Michael Sattler and adopted February 24, 1527 at Schleitheim (canton Schaffhausen).
The seven articles address baptism, the ban, breaking of bread, separation, pastors, the sword, and the oath.
